decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing that the SK6812 LEDs are powered from the switched 5V rail; no additional update or removal is required.
The LED supply and data-level-shifter decision does not change the sensor-board connector matrix.
The panel reset connector and EN-to-GND behavior are unrelated to the addressable LED electrical interface.
Rejecting 3.3V as the SK6812 supply does not alter the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail, its regulator, or its listed loads.
The source leaves the AXP2101 DCDC1 3.3V output and its normal-operation role unchanged.
The candidate records the independent LED-board array count, which remains eight; electrical supply and level shifting are owned by the source Requirement.
The PIR connector requirement is unaffected by the SK6812 supply and data-level-shifter selection.
The source does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
Panel button and switch GPIO mappings are unrelated to the addressable LED electrical change.
The TTP223 touch connectors and GPIO assignments remain unchanged.
The source does not change the AXP2101, the battery power path, or the required 3.3V and 5V system rails.
Powering the LEDs from the existing 5V rail does not change which rails must be monitored or the available monitor-channel count.
